title: landing-operations: refresh at any K when main moved a shared budget (skills token ratchet, eager-chunk ceilings) since the PR's base
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQTVjryTSkqydKVS6z

Filing-gate category: ① process defect, measured. `reach:` the #31518 7-day re-reading of every merge-queue root, 2026-11-09..15 (comment 6904236520, class (a) rows 10, 11, 60). Parent card #31518 (p1, `domain:devx`), Wanted 2 for class (a).

## What happened

Class (a), stale base, had 7 roots, 13 cascades and 180 minutes of `main` standing still in the window. The K ≥ 15 refresh rule (`landing-operations.md` line 45, from #31548 / PR #31571) was in force all week and caught none of them. Two of the seven are **shared-budget ledgers**, where every PR spends from one headroom, so two PRs that are green on their own go red together in the queue:

- Rows 10–11, PR #32050: Build & E2E UI eager-closure budget. `i18n-locale-en` was 60.6 KB against its 60.5 KB ceiling, because #32129 and #32028 (en strings) landed after the PR run's base. It was enqueued at K 11, and the same queue stay rebuilt it at K 15 with the head unchanged, red again.
- Row 60, PR #33355: the published-skills token ratchet, K 227 (enqueued by hand outside the seat procedure). Step 1 (6722460022) had 29 skills-ratchet reds of the same shape.

## Ask (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md`, governed)

1. Widen the existing any-K clause on line 45 (a locale PR whose base predates a new locale landing) to a PR that spends a shared budget: `skills/**` against the published-skills token ratchet, and ui eager-chunk locale or strings files against `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS`. Such a PR merges `main` first at any K when `main` has moved that budget since the PR's base.
2. Name how the seat reads "moved that budget" cheaply (for example, `git diff --name-only PRBASE..origin/main` touching the ledger's inputs).
3. Proof: the rule caught rows 10, 11 and 60 when replayed against the re-reading's table (8 cascades, 23 rebuilt builds).

⛔ No gate made report-only, no ceiling raised, no merge-queue setting changed.

Reader: `domain:skills` lane seat, from `pm:queue`. Dedupe: `landing-operations any K shared budget`, `token ratchet refresh enqueue`, no open hit; related #31548 (closed, the K rule), #34152 (flake p0 rule, different class). Priority p2: it removes about 3 roots a week from the queue.
